notes: Guidelines PDF (dated December 2025, 4 pages) downloaded and read in full with pdftotext; quotes string-matched. eos.org/submit blocked raw curl (Cloudflare), so it was read only through the WebFetch summarizer; its quotes are marked checked_in_text false.

items.quote: An Opinion should engage or move forward a conversation in the science community. Maximum length: 1,500 words
items.source: Eos Author Guidelines for Accepted Proposals, December 2025 (PDF)

items.value_text: identify a problem in the Earth and space science community (cultural or scientific) and offer solutions; move quickly to recommendations if the problem is widely known
items.quote: Opinions identify a problem within the Earth and space science community (culturally or scientifically) and offer solutions for the reader.

items.value_text: no more than 12; hyperlinks to sources are an accepted and sometimes preferred alternative
items.quote: keep references to a minimum (no more than 12)

items.value_text: in-line citations with a reference list at the end are allowed; linking text to outside sources is an alternative and 'in some cases ... the preferred and/or necessary approach'; the submit page says Eos prefers hyperlinks
items.quote: An alternative to formal, in-line citations and references is to link text in your article to outside information or references

items.value_text: not found (no numeric cap; figures must be simple, non-technical and may be redesigned or declined)
items.quote: Figures must be high-resolution, relatively simple (including only information covered by the manuscript), and visually interesting.

items.value_text: required: an eye-catching landscape photograph, not a figure, collage or map; separate .jpg/.png files with caption and credit; permissions needed
items.quote: Provide an eye-catching, landscape-oriented photograph to lead the story.

items.value_text: up to 64 characters including spaces; no acronyms or abbreviations
items.quote: Headlines may be up to 64 characters long, including spaces.

items.value_text: up to 200 characters including spaces; must not repeat the headline
items.quote: A teaser summary that accompanies the headline (but does not repeat it) can be up to 200 characters, including spaces.

items.value_text: not found (neither the guidelines PDF nor the submit page mentions a bio)
5; only people who write the manuscript; no project-team names
items.quote: We allow a maximum of 5 authors per article.

items.value_text: narrative, not Abstract-Introduction-Methods; significance in first or second paragraph; subsections with subtitles; minimal lists
items.quote: Authors should state clearly and succinctly in the first or second paragraph the significance of the topic

items.value_text: must not have been published before, including as a preprint; posting drafts under Eos editing is not permitted
items.quote: your manuscript should not have been published previously in print or online (including as a preprint)

items.value_text: .docx/.doc (or .txt); no PDF, no cloud links, no line numbers
items.quote: Submit articles as Microsoft Word documents (.docx or .doc) or, if necessary, as .txt documents.

items.value_text: proposal (outline, not a manuscript) via a Google Form linked from eos.org/submit; after acceptance, drafts go through Basecamp with the corresponding author only
items.quote: Scientists may submit proposals through this form
items.source: eos.org/submit (read via WebFetch summarizer; direct curl blocked by Cloudflare)

items.value_text: proposals and articles may not be written, in part or full, with AI tools
items.quote: Proposals (and articles) may not be written—in part or full—using artificial intelligence (AI) tools.
items.source: eos.org/submit (WebFetch summary by subagent; page text re-read in browser by main session)
items.notes: Re-read in the eos.org/submit page text (browser innerText) on 2026-10-30 in the main session.

items.value_text: proposal response within 4 weeks; manuscript due within 6 weeks of acceptance; about 8 weeks in queue; 14-18 weeks proposal to publication
items.quote: Time from proposal to publication is between 14 and 18 weeks.
items.source: eos.org/submit (WebFetch summary by subagent; page text re-read in browser by main session)
